text:
ryan.t: Hi everyone, trying to accept the GitHub org invite but getting an error: 'Email alias not allowed' after I click accept. I used my work email ryan.t@redwood.ai — what now?
kelly-peopleops: welcome Ryan! tagging IT: @it-support-bot. Do you see the full error or a link in the invite email?
it-support-bot: Checking. The org provisioning logs show GitHub receiving the address as ryan.t+personal@redwood.ai (an alias). Our SCIM policy disallows aliases for account creation. Did you forward the invite or use an email client rule?
ryan.t: hmm I sometimes use plus-addressing for filters. The invite link came to ryan.t@redwood.ai though, not the +personal. I clicked accept from my phone where my personal GH account is active — could that have rewritten the recipient?
it-support-bot: Possibly. If you accept while logged into a different GH session, the browser may try to attach the invite to that account and GitHub can normalize the address. Two clean options: (1) Accept in an incognito browser while signed out of personal GH, or (2) IT can issue a new invite using the "create account" flow that enforces a separate work account. Which do you prefer?
ryan.t: I'd rather keep accounts separate. Go with option 2. Also need access to redwood/docs and infra so I can follow the setup guides.
marc-eng: For infra access, we usually give read + triage first. Tag me when you have org access and I'll add you to infra-reviewers.
it-support-bot: Reissuing invite at 2026-06-07T08:12:40Z via explicit new-account flow, flagged as SAML/SSO required. Pre-added to docs-readers and infra-read. Note: org requires SAML SSO, so you'll need to complete SSO via the IdP before team repos show.
devex-zoe: Quick tip: when creating the work account, enable 2FA immediately and add your SSH key under Settings > SSH and GPG keys. If you use VSCode GH extension, run `gh auth login --web` after SSO.
ryan.t: got the new invite and tried to accept. It prompted to create an account but after SSO I got "Provisioning error: account not in required IdP group". I did accept the Okta invite earlier — not sure why group membership is missing.
elizabeth? (note: we didn't include elizabeth in participants)
it-support-bot: That error means SCIM didn't map you into the correct GitHub team-group. Kelly, can you confirm the Okta group assignment?
kelly-peopleops: I see Ryan in Okta as part of 'engineering' but not in 'engineering-dev'. For SAML provisioning to grant repo teams we require 'engineering-dev' membership. I can add you now.
it-support-bot: Manually triggering SCIM sync with GitHub now. This should provision SSO and team membership; give it a minute then logout and back in.
marc-eng: When SSO flips on, teams will appear. If you still see 403 on repo clone, try `gh auth refresh -h github.com` or delete stale PATs in your machine keychain.
ryan.t: SCIM sync completed and SSO is approved. I can see the docs repo but `git clone git@github.com:redwood/infra.git` still returns permission denied (publickey).
devex-zoe: That sounds like an SSH key issue. Did you add your SSH public key to your new work account?
ryan.t: I added a key but maybe used the wrong one. How do I check which key my ssh agent is using?
marc-eng: Run `ssh -T git@github.com -vvv` to see which key files are offered. If it's offering your personal key, adjust `~/.ssh/config` with `Host github.com
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_rsa_work` or run `ssh-add` with the right key.
it-support-bot: Also ensure you didn't accidentally add the public key to your personal account. Only add the work key to the work account. If you want, paste the public key here and we can confirm format (don't paste private keys).
ryan.t: Fixed SSH config, can clone infra now. Thanks. One more thing: I opened an infra/repo-access request asking for write on docs for a tiny formatting PR. How long does approval usually take?
kelly-peopleops: Approvals typically happen within a day; @marc-eng often approves quick doc PRs same-day. If it's urgent, DM Marc directly.
marc-eng: Approved your write for redwood/docs. Welcome aboard and sorry for the alias hassle — +addressing and multiple GH sessions are a common trap.
ryan.t: All set, can push and opened my PR. Appreciate the quick help everyone :party_parrot:
